convert_hot3d_clips_to_bop_scenewise: run the script to convert Hot3D-Clips dataset to BOP scenewise format using --hot3d-dataset-path and --split args
convert_quest3_split: run the conversion script with --split train_quest3 to process Meta Quest 3 camera streams as gray1 and gray2
convert_aria_split: run the conversion script with --split train_aria to process Aria camera streams as rgb, gray1, and gray2
process_clip_to_bop: run the process_clip function to convert a single tar clip file into BOP scenewise format with camera, gt, and gt_info JSON
convert_rle_to_mask: run the custom_rle_to_mask function to convert a custom RLE list into a 2D binary numpy array mask
